source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Diagnose asthma for the very first time in a client who has never before been formally evaluated for the condition by a provider","B":"Carrying fairly little established value for a client who is actively managing their own day-to-day asthma symptoms at home","C":"Objectively track changes in airflow over time, helping identify early signs of worsening asthma control, sometimes before symptoms become apparent","D":"Taking the place of the other asthma monitoring methods the client would otherwise still need to continue using regularly"}}
source_row.rationale: Peak flow monitoring, tracked against the client's personal best value, helps objectively track changes in airflow over time, sometimes identifying early signs of worsening asthma control before symptoms become clinically apparent, supporting timely self-management action per the client's asthma action plan.
source_row.source_name: National Asthma Education and Prevention Program — Peak Flow Monitoring
